::: {#def-simulation-study}
#### Simulation study

A **simulation study** runs $M$ [replications](#def-replication)
of one [data-generating process](#def-data-generating-process)
and one [estimator](estimation.qmd#def-estimator),
then summarizes the estimates $T_1, \ldots, T_M$
to learn the estimator's [sampling distribution](estimation.qmd#def-sampling-distribution).
:::
